title: "R Basics"

Quarto understands R Markdown style chunks. You can mix text and code to make a "sexy looking" book.

### Objects and vectors

```{r}
x <- 1:5
mean(x)
sd(x)
```

### Data wrangling example (dplyr)

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
if (!requireNamespace("dplyr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("dplyr")
}
library(dplyr)

mtcars %>% 
  group_by(cyl) %>% 
  summarise(avg_mpg = mean(mpg), .groups = "drop")
```

### A ggplot example

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("ggplot2")
}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal()
```
